recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現成群的大型非造血細胞：細胞核圓而偏位、核仁可見、細胞質豐富且淡染，與周圍嗜中性球明顯不同；切片中同樣的大細胞呈核染色陽性的免疫染色，支持轉移性黑色素瘤細胞。
features: Clusters of large cells in peripheral blood, several times the size of neutrophils (A)
Round, eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin and visible nucleoli; abundant pale, lightly basophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders (B)
No melanin pigment clearly identifiable at this resolution
H&E section with scattered large epithelioid cells with vesicular nuclei among blood elements (C)
Nuclear immunostaining in a cohesive cluster of tumor cells (D; marker not labeled)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of large atypical cells, markedly larger than accompanying neutrophils, with round eccentric nuclei, visible nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm; melanin pigment is not clearly discernible at this resolution. A corresponding H&E section shows scattered large epithelioid cells with vesicular nuclei, and an immunohistochemical stain shows strong nuclear positivity in a cluster of tumor cells (antibody not labeled in the figure). These cells are morphologically non-hematopoietic. Findings are consistent with circulating metastatic melanoma cells, supported by immunophenotyping (e.g., SOX10, S100, Melan-A, HMB-45).

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells tend to form tighter cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive and SOX10/Melan-A negative.
Megakaryocytic cells have lobulated nuclei or cytoplasmic blebs with platelet budding and express CD61/CD42b rather than melanocytic markers.
Hematolymphoid cells are dispersed rather than clustered and express CD45; melanoma cells are CD45 negative.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cells or squamous contaminants from venipuncture
ddx.vs: Contaminant cells have bland small nuclei, no nucleoli and do not show atypia or melanocytic marker expression.
